_doc: flh_transcribe tables - edit freely; the code falls back to its built-in copy if this file is missing or broken. chord_qualities: chord suffix -> semitones from the root (the vocabulary audio chord recognition chooses from). harmonic_decay/harmonics: how chord templates model each tone's overtones. drum_bands_hz: band edges for the drum hit analysis. drums: class -> GM note (+ open-hat and tom variants). drum_rules: thresholds (levels relative to the recording's own 90th percentiles; noise_peak_share = energy share of the strongest 5% of bins in what a hit added: noise ~0.2-0.4, a pitched attack > 0.6; snare_top_ratio caps how much top end a snare is assumed to bring - more than that is a hat on top). midi_channels: MIDI channel per part in written .mid files (9 = GM drums).
seventh_note: a 7th chord needs its 7th's chroma to beat the triad's own harmonics by seventh_min_excess (else seventh_penalty); chord MIDI voices 7ths only when the chart confidence >= seventh_voice_min_conf
